correction.actual_definition: Maximum root XY distance from the reset position over the entire first episode, NOT the terminal root displacement.
correction.cause: The legacy evaluator serialized its running torch.maximum radius accumulator into this ambiguously named field.

unavailable_from_original_report: Actual terminal root displacement XY vector and its norm
Actual terminal signed-world-velocity integral norm before reset
interpretation_limit: A maximum excursion greater than 0.20 m does not establish a terminal boundary violation. The terminal-only boundary can correctly charge zero when its final integrated displacement is within 0.20 m. This sidecar does not infer the missing terminal values.
new_fields: first_episode_end.terminal_integrated_displacement_m (only when a pre-reset diagnostic is available)
